    First arrows of contours (BO13a, Lemma 4 b)) #

    In a ray category with left cancellation, the two paths of a contour start with incomparable irreducible morphisms (RayCat.not_bLe_first_of_contour): otherwise the first arrows agree and the paths are interlaced. Hence a neighbour ρ of σ = val v = val w in a crown cannot factor through both paths (RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_factors_both, BO13a Lemma 4 b)).

      BO13a, Lemma 4 b): a morphism ρ incomparable with σ = val v = val w from a contour (v, w) does not factor through the first arrows of both paths.
